bone_loss.class_order_note: binary class order derived from the FocalLoss alpha [0.642, 2.258] against counts (2500 normal / 711 diseased); the checkpoint carries no class_to_idx. Inferred, not read.

limitations.interpretation: Detection recall and FDI accuracy are measured on DENTEX disease/ (164 leak-free images, RESULTS_LOG 2026-08-22j). A missed tooth is absent from this report; a misnumbered tooth carries correct findings under the wrong FDI code. Expect roughly half the codes in this report to be wrong.
limitations.caries_gate_out_of_distribution: The caries gate's negative class is Impacted + Periapical Lesion and contains no healthy teeth, while this pipeline feeds it every detected tooth. MEASURED over 12 leak-free DENTEX images (299 detected teeth, RESULTS_LOG 2026-08-24f): it calls 84.9% of teeth carious against 35 annotated carious teeth -- roughly a 7x over-call. An 85% caries rate is not clinically plausible. Treat every caries field in this report as uncalibrated.
limitations.bone_loss_domain_shift: The bone-loss models were trained on TUFTS radiographs and are applied here to whatever image is supplied; on DENTEX they fire on 0.7% of teeth (2/299) with 0.93-0.999 confidence in 'normal'. The branch is close to inert out of its training domain -- the opposite failure to the caries gate. A 'normal' bone-loss field is therefore weak evidence, not a negative finding.
